EuroPeir Hub

Which container, which truck, which driver?

Every pickup needs three things free at the same time, plus a plant that will take the waste. Dispatch used to work that out one check at a time. I designed the console where they can see it: review a request, plan it on one timeline, watch the day, and give management a dashboard that only raises its voice when something is wrong.

1st column
Late jobs get the first column of the board. Alerts get the first block of the dashboard
